records.caseDetails: 47 mm steel; wire lugs; display back per auction catalogue
records.conclusion: Original Christie’s lot2449 identifies PAM00425 with OP6837 and hand-wound P.3000,21jewels. Its2012 dating and O0019/1500 number apply to that auction specimen; they do not date the saved watch or establish the complete production interval. Actual photograph shows black dot/baton S.L.C. dial, submarine emblem, gold-tone hands, wire lugs and brown strap. No opened movement, back or buckle detail photograph is accepted. Saved P.3000 agrees with the model attribution; OP6837 is not promoted as a lookup alias. Reference mapping answered only; physical authenticity, service history and component originality remain unverified. No neighbouring reference inherits this mapping. Original Watches of Switzerland exact-reference retail specification independently confirms hand-wound P.3000 and three-day nominal reserve.
